On the right side (Store): A dark, indoor jute sack spilling harvested groundnuts; some groundnuts are covered in fuzzy green and black mould (Aspergillus). A close-up illustration of a cocoa tree branch showing two pods. One pod is healthy and yellow/green. The other pod is entirely black and rotting, with a fuzzy whitish fungal growth visible on the surface.

A cassava leaf showing classic mosaic virus symptoms. Instead of a uniform deep green, the leaf is mottled with bright yellow and pale green patches, and the edges are curled and distorted. Beside it, a magnified inset of a tiny whitefly.
